summary:
Art-direction review of mockup 15 ("Beer Die Studio"). I rendered the original at 1440x900 and 390x844, sampled pixel colours, and tested every fix below on copies. Edited copies and renders are in C:\Users\wccoy\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\C--Projects-sigma-chi-website\6bf3cb6c-9ead-4650-a69f-a89411f0a84f\scratchpad\shots\wf15\art\ (the experiment HTML files and renders are in the exp subfolder).

What already works: the bloom, HUD, trails and code rain are gone; edges are crisp; the closing card and buttons match the live site's editorial style; and the desktop layout (figure in the left third, table on a diagonal, card top-right) is sound.

What keeps it from reading as a high-end render:
- The navy turns into slate grey after the crane: 82% of the desktop end frame is grey-blue under 35% saturation, and the phone's table renders #6d7786.
- The white figure reads as an artist's posing mannequin.
- The phone shot leaves the table tiny under a black void, and the closing card hides the landing.
- At scroll 0, a grey haze on the right third and streaky grain make the hero noticeably less clean than the live hero.
- The celebration and end poses misread.

A combined copy with art-1 through art-6 applied (C:\Users\wccoy\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\C--Projects-sigma-chi-website\6bf3cb6c-9ead-4650-a69f-a89411f0a84f\scratchpad\shots\wf15\art\exp\v6-all.html) renders as a navy studio: 4% grey, 70% navy, with a bronze figure. C:\Users\wccoy\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\C--Projects-sigma-chi-website\6bf3cb6c-9ead-4650-a69f-a89411f0a84f\scratchpad\shots\wf15\art\exp\v7-geom.html adds the figure geometry tweak. The patch script with exact old/new strings is C:\Users\wccoy\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\C--Projects-sigma-chi-website\6bf3cb6c-9ead-4650-a69f-a89411f0a84f\scratchpad\shots\wf15\art\tools\variants.py.

Caveats:
- Renders at a sought time can catch the camera still settling (`sf` eases at 12% per frame under SwiftShader), so framing differs slightly between shots.
- Running several renders in parallel sometimes left the scene unloaded. Those frames were re-shot one at a time.

findings.title: After the crane the navy turns to slate grey: off-palette across most of the frame, and the phone table goes grey
findings.evidence:
Desktop end frame (C:\Users\wccoy\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\C--Projects-sigma-chi-website\6bf3cb6c-9ead-4650-a69f-a89411f0a84f\scratchpad\shots\wf15\art\o-d-06.png), measured:
- backdrop #2b3342 and floor #2a3547 / #303a4c, all at 21-26% saturation; brand navy #0b2545 is 72%.
- The far half of the table, where the target cup and landed die sit, washes out to #4a586f.
- Outside the nav and card, 82% of pixels are blue at under 35% saturation; only 9% are navy (50% or more).

Phone at t=1.88 (C:\Users\wccoy\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\C--Projects-sigma-chi-website\6bf3cb6c-9ead-4650-a69f-a89411f0a84f\scratchpad\shots\wf15\art\o-m-01.png): floor #505a6b (14% saturation) and table top #6d7786 (10%). The navy table itself reads grey, with a white glare blob beside the target cup.

Cause: the dark floor (0x0d1b30, roughness 0.62) mostly shows the neutral white specular of the softbox environment, and the table's lacquer specular ramps to 0.4. The near-black background (0x07111f) against the lit grey floor also leaves a hard 'sky band' at the top of the phone frame.
findings.fix:
Keep AgX tone mapping: ACES was tested and crushes the near table to #0a0e19. Make these changes:
- L863-864: `scene.background = new T.Color(0x071931); scene.fog = new T.Fog(0x071931, 22, 52);`
- L951 floor: `new T.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x0b2545, roughness: 0.95, metalness: 0, envMapIntensity: 0.12 })`
- L899: `scene.add(new T.HemisphereLight(0x8fa8d8, 0x071931, 0.22));`
- L907 topMat: `envMapIntensity: 0.55` -> `0.3`
- L1152: `topMat.specularIntensity = lerp(0.08, 0.12, c);`

Tested (C:\Users\wccoy\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\C--Projects-sigma-chi-website\6bf3cb6c-9ead-4650-a69f-a89411f0a84f\scratchpad\shots\wf15\art\exp\v1-d-5.png):
- backdrop #0a1b34 (68%), floor #102643 (61%), near table #012041.
- Grey share drops from 82% to 4% and navy rises from 9% to 70%.
- Phone floor becomes #233754 with 7% grey.

The die in flight stays legible against the navy: its lit faces, gold pips and clear-coat edges carry it.

findings.title: The 'marble statue' renders as a white jointed posing mannequin, the most amateur-looking element in the frame
findings.fix:
Line 568: `const stone = new T.MeshPhysicalMaterial({ color: 0x9a7a3a, metalness: 1, roughness: 0.34, envMapIntensity: 1.25 });`. The marble map and `paintMarble` then become unused.

Optional refinement, tested in C:\Users\wccoy\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\C--Projects-sigma-chi-website\6bf3cb6c-9ead-4650-a69f-a89411f0a84f\scratchpad\shots\wf15\art\exp\cmp-geom.png. It blends the shoulder domes and removes the collar ring:
- L598: `joint(spine, side * 0.68, 1.5, 0)` (was 0.76).
- L485: upper-arm prof starts `[[0.2, 0.1, 0.1], [0.12, 0.22, 0.22], [0, 0.28, 0.28], ...`.
- L478: head prof first ring `[0, 0.19, 0.18]` (was `[0, 0.13, 0.13]`).

findings.title: Phone framing: small, distant table under a black void, and the closing card hides the landing
findings.evidence:
At 390x844 (C:\Users\wccoy\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\C--Projects-sigma-chi-website\6bf3cb6c-9ead-4650-a69f-a89411f0a84f\scratchpad\shots\wf15\art\base-m-strip.png), all the action sits in the band y≈230-656:
- The top 27% is near-black #07111f void; the bottom 22% is empty floor.
- The far cups are only ~97 px apart, and the die at the apex is a ~15 px speck.
- At t=1.88 the figure is clipped by the left edge (C:\Users\wccoy\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\C--Projects-sigma-chi-website\6bf3cb6c-9ead-4650-a69f-a89411f0a84f\scratchpad\shots\wf15\art\o-m-01.png).
- In the end state (t=5.0) the card covers y≈404-758, 42% of the screen, and hides the figure and most of the table.
- The payoff, the die in the far-right cup at (313, 379), is a ~10 px white speck at the card's top edge.
- The card's eyebrow also wraps, leaving 'CLASS' alone on its own line.

findings.title: Scroll 0 doesn't match the live hero: grey haze on the right third and streaky grain
findings.evidence:
Sampled C:\Users\wccoy\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\C--Projects-sigma-chi-website\6bf3cb6c-9ead-4650-a69f-a89411f0a84f\scratchpad\shots\wf15\art\o-d-00.png against the live HeroBanner gradient at the same points:
- At (1400,120), 15 renders #243957 (41% saturation, 24% lightness); the live hero is #091e39 (73%, 13%).
- At (1400,500), 15 renders #213552; the live hero is #081c37.
- So 15's gradient runs the wrong way, lighter and greyer at the right, behind the crest watermark.

Cause, isolated by fading each light: the key spot at (8,13,-1). Its highlight on the table lands at x≈1.91 ft, which is the right edge of the overhead view (visible half-width 1.75 ft).

The 900 grain strokes in paintTop at 5-13% alpha read as vertical scan streaks across the whole field (C:\Users\wccoy\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\C--Projects-sigma-chi-website\6bf3cb6c-9ead-4650-a69f-a89411f0a84f\scratchpad\shots\wf15\art\z-hero-grain.png). The live hero is a clean gradient.

findings.title: Pose beats misread: the 'fist pump' looks like a raised hand, and the closing pose is a mannequin display pose
findings.evidence:
With paddle hands, the one-arm pump (rex 1.35) reads as raising a hand or waving, not celebrating (C:\Users\wccoy\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\C--Projects-sigma-chi-website\6bf3cb6c-9ead-4650-a69f-a89411f0a84f\scratchpad\shots\wf15\art\o-d-05.png).

The frame that stays on screen under the closing card returns to POSE.idle (C:\Users\wccoy\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\C--Projects-sigma-chi-website\6bf3cb6c-9ead-4650-a69f-a89411f0a84f\scratchpad\shots\wf15\art\o-d-06.png). In idle, the right forearm is held flat across the belly (rex 1.25), the gesture for presenting the die. With the hand now empty it reads like a shop-window mannequin.
findings.fix:
Edit POSE:
- `pump: { dy: 0.05, pt: 0.05, sx: -0.06, sy: 0.06, hx: -0.2, rsx: 2.7, rsz: 0.5, rex: 0.25, rwx: 0, lsx: 2.7, lsz: -0.5, lex: 0.25, lwx: 0 }` (both arms up in a V).
- Add `rest: { dy: 0, pt: 0.04, sx: 0.02, sy: 0.12, hx: -0.08, rsx: 0.15, rsz: 0.24, rex: 0.3, rwx: 0.05, lsx: 0.05, lsz: -0.26, lex: 0.3, lwx: 0 }`.

In poseAt:
- Change the keys to start `[[0, k.prev ? POSE.rest : POSE.idle], [dl, POSE.idle], ...`.
- Change the last key to `[k.end, POSE.rest]`.
- Extend the wave with `p.lsx += 0.3 * wv; p.lex -= 0.2 * wv;`.

In frame(), L1118: `rig.apply(toss ? rig.poseAt(tossT, toss, dieY, dieDist) : { ...(restMode === "cup" ? POSE.rest : POSE.idle) });`

Tested: the V reads as 'score' (C:\Users\wccoy\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\C--Projects-sigma-chi-website\6bf3cb6c-9ead-4650-a69f-a89411f0a84f\scratchpad\shots\wf15\art\exp\v6-d-3.6.png), and the end stance hangs relaxed with no pop when the toss ends (C:\Users\wccoy\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\C--Projects-sigma-chi-website\6bf3cb6c-9ead-4650-a69f-a89411f0a84f\scratchpad\shots\wf15\art\exp\v6-d-5.png).

findings.title: The ΣΧ table monogram lies sideways from the desktop camera
findings.evidence:
In every desktop three-quarter frame (C:\Users\wccoy\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\C--Projects-sigma-chi-website\6bf3cb6c-9ead-4650-a69f-a89411f0a84f\scratchpad\shots\wf15\art\o-d-06.png) the decal reads rotated 90 degrees, like a mis-applied sticker.

The camera sits at +x, so screen-right is world -z, but the decal's text runs along +x. A brand mark at the centre of the hero render should face the camera. The phone camera, from behind the thrower, already reads it upright.
findings.fix:
In `resize()`, after `camera.updateProjectionMatrix();` add `mono.rotation.set(-Math.PI / 2, 0, camera.aspect < 0.8 ? 0 : Math.PI / 2);`. The decal then spans z 0.15-2.55, clear of the centre inlay and the cups.

Tested: upright ΣΧ on desktop (C:\Users\wccoy\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\C--Projects-sigma-chi-website\6bf3cb6c-9ead-4650-a69f-a89411f0a84f\scratchpad\shots\wf15\art\exp\v6-d-5.png) and on phone (C:\Users\wccoy\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\C--Projects-sigma-chi-website\6bf3cb6c-9ead-4650-a69f-a89411f0a84f\scratchpad\shots\wf15\art\exp\v6-m-5.png).

findings.title: The scrolled nav smears the card's gold CTA into a glow, the last 'glowy' artifact
findings.evidence:
As the stage scrolls away (C:\Users\wccoy\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\C--Projects-sigma-chi-website\6bf3cb6c-9ead-4650-a69f-a89411f0a84f\scratchpad\shots\wf15\art\o-d-s0.png, scroll 42%), the closing card's gold button and the figure's head pass under the frosted nav. They show as a #4a3b11 gold smear and a #3c3f47 pale smear on a #131c2d bar.

The cause: `.nav--solid` uses rgba(3, 10, 22, .62) with saturate(160%) blur(18px). The live NavBar.css uses rgba(11, 37, 69, .82).
findings.fix: Line 55: change the background to `rgba(11, 37, 69, .82)`, the live site's value, and keep the blur. At 82% opacity the bleed-through drops to under a fifth and the nav reads navy, not near-black. This is the only fix not rendered; the value is copied from the live NavBar.css.
